text:
priya: Heads-up — need a quick sync on error taxonomy + new dashboard inputs for the rollout next week. TL;DR: runtime will emit fallback_count and degraded_mode tag; infra will emit oom_kb and 5xx_rate. Need stable names and owners.

matt: +1. We also need timeout buckets (50-200ms, 200-500ms, >500ms) — otherwise we can't separate short timeouts from long tails. Can runtime emit timeout_bucket?

sasha: runtime can add timeout_bucket & fallback_count. OOM is a bit noisy — kernel vs process kills. We'll emit oom_event:true and oom_rss_kb when available, plus an oom_reason label if we can parse it.

elaine: Console note: we'll need stable metric names and labels: service, model_version (or model_family?), route_policy. Proposal: redwood.runtime.fallbacks.count, redwood.runtime.degraded_mode.gauge, redwood.infra.oom_kb.gauge. Thoughts?

alex: Agree on labels. Suggest adding fallback_reason tag (quantize/oom/quota/routing) — that lets us split graphs easily.

kevin: routing-policies team here — route_policy label is fine but can be high-cardinality. We should limit allowed values to a small enum (primary, canary, cheap_fallback).

priya: Good call. Proposed route_policy enum: primary, canary, fallback_low_cost, fallback_high_latency. Keep it small.

console-ui: noted — will build a dashboard template that uses those labels. Need sample metric payloads + example queries to wire panels.

infra-bot: deploy:runtime/1.32 published with metric: redwood.runtime.fallbacks.count (label=fallback_reason).

matt: sweet. Can we get a telemetry schema PR with examples so dashboards can be drafted?

sasha: I'll open the schema PR. It will include: histogram redwood.runtime.timeout_ms with buckets [50,200,500,1000,5000], counter redwood.http.5xx_total with label=status_code, gauge redwood.infra.oom_rss_kb, counter redwood.runtime.fallbacks.count with label=fallback_reason, gauge redwood.runtime.degraded_mode (0/1) and label=route_policy.

elaine: Dashboard requests: top-5 models (model_family) by 5xx rate, fallback rate over time, OOM incidents timeline (annotation on graph), degraded mode % slice by route_policy. Also alert rules: prod 5xx_rate > 0.5% for 5m, fallback_rate increase > 3x baseline.

kevin: quotas team needs quota_breach_count metric. We'll emit redwood.quota.rejects with label=policy. That'll help attribute fallback_reason=quota vs fallback_reason=oom.

priya: Owners: runtime=sasha, infra=kevin, console/dashboard=elaine, rollout/product=matt. Action items: schema PR (sasha) by EOD tomorrow, sample traces/log lines (matt) by EOD, dashboard proto (elaine) by Friday, alert proposals (kevin) by Monday. I'll centralize in /docs/metrics/reliability.md.

alex: small note — keep telemetry low-cardinality. avoid model_id in metrics; use model_family or model_tier.

sasha: acknowledged. We'll add model_family label and model_tier (small enum).

matt: quick question on fallback_count semantics — is that per-request or per-token?

priya: per-request. fallback_count increments once if a request triggers any fallback during processing.

elaine: UI will treat it per-request. We'll display a tooltip explaining semantics and show example query.

kevin: also add latency SLA buckets to the dashboard (p50/p95/p99 + timeout buckets).

priya: Great. Closing loop: I'll draft the ontology doc and tag owners. Thanks all — appreciate the quick alignment. :tada:

alex: :thumbsup:

infra-bot: note: telemetry-schema PR issue created -> #5678 (sasha).
